triggers.label: Uncorrelated Account — IAM Decision
triggers.description: Fires when an IAM review is started for an orphan/uncorrelated account from the Data Hygiene page

triggers.label: Certification Signed Off
triggers.description: Fires when a certification item is signed off with a decision

triggers.label: Joiner Detected
triggers.description: Fires when a Joiner provisioning request is created after HRMS identity insert + rule match

actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Deny Access Request
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Get Access
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Get Identity
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Get Identity History
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Get List of Identities
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Get Pending Access Requests
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: HTTP Request
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Get Certification Item
actions.description: Reads identity and access from the certification trigger payload

actions.label: Manage Access
actions.description: Provision or remove access on the target system (revoke)

actions.label: Revoke Access
actions.description: Removes the access item from the target system

actions.label: Manage Accounts
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Manage ServiceNow Ticket
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Send Email
actions.description: Sends a notification email to the user, manager, or any recipient

actions.label: Send Slack Message
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Verify Access Removed
actions.description: Checks whether the entitlement still exists after revoke

actions.label: Create Ticket
actions.description: Creates a remediation ticket (Internal provider); populate fields from the trigger

actions.label: Get Ticket
actions.description: Reads ticket status/owner for the created ticket (for human-in-the-loop flows)

actions.label: Update Ticket
actions.description: Updates fields (status, priority, assignee, comments) on the ticket

actions.label: Close Ticket
actions.description: Closes the ticket with an optional resolution note

actions.label: Update Queue Task
actions.description: Sets the remediation queue task status (e.g. COMPLETED) from the canvas

actions.label: Audit Log
actions.description: Records governance evidence

actions.label: Wait
actions.description: ISC action (not yet executable)

actions.label: Wait / Delay
actions.description: Pause workflow and resume after a delay (used for ticket polling loops)

actions.label: Get Orphan Context
actions.description: Loads orphan account, application, and enriched identity fields for downstream email templates

actions.label: Orphan Reminder Schedule
actions.description: Configure once: reminder phases (e.g. 1h,3h,6h,12h) stored on the execution for the background scheduler

actions.label: Create Uncorrelated Account Record
actions.description: Legacy — initiates governance review (use Get Orphan Context in new flows)

actions.label: Assign IAM Team
actions.description: Marks the orphan account as UNDER_REVIEW and assigns it to the IAM team for action

actions.label: Wait for Portal Decision
actions.description: Pauses until a decision is submitted via the review portal link (IAM, manager, or other recipient)

actions.label: Wait for Joiner Approval
actions.description: Pauses Joiner provisioning until an approver records APPROVED or REJECTED

actions.label: Check Joiner Decision
actions.description: Branches on Joiner approval decision (APPROVED vs REJECTED)

actions.label: Provision Joiner Account
actions.description: After approval, compiles Provisioning Plan and ADD_ACCOUNT task (connector worker executes)

actions.label: Reject Joiner Request
actions.description: Cancels Joiner provisioning request without creating an executable task

actions.label: Scheduler Check
actions.description: Sends a scheduled reminder email to the IAM team if no decision has been recorded yet

actions.label: Decision Received?
actions.description: Reads the IAM decision from the orphan account and passes it downstream

operators.label: IAM Decision Taken?
operators.description: Branches Yes when IAM submitted a decision; No while still waiting

operators.label: Boolean
operators.description: Branch on a condition (uses Compare Strings)

operators.label: If / Compare Strings
operators.description: Branch Yes/No on string equality (e.g. email sent, ticket CLOSED)

operators.label: Switch
operators.description: Multi-branch on a field value (e.g. IAM decision ASSIGN/DELETE/DISABLE)

operators.label: Verify Data Type
operators.description: Check if a field exists or is null

operators.label: End Step — Waiting
operators.description: Workflow parked awaiting provisioning / ITSM; re-verified on schedule
